business: Nørreværk — an architecture bureau in Copenhagen and Malmö that works only on conversion, extension and repair of buildings that already exist. Sixteen people, founded 2011. Its commercial first step is a paid two-week condition survey written by a partner, and about a third of those end with the bureau advising against the project.
